title: Watersound "Tidepool Treasure" 24 Tidepool Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Short 5 minute walk or bike ride to the beach or pool- Professionally designed- Gourmet kitchen- Fireplace- 4 passenger golf cart- 5 adult bikes- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private Deeded Beach Access- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout*This property comes with 3 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 3 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: If you're searching for an inviting yet luxurious home for your next 30A vacation, look no further. "Tidepool Treasure" in WaterSound is a beautifully updated home in the center of the community, just a 5 minute walk to the private beach and neighborhood pool. This 5-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom retreat can accommodate 12 guests comfortably. You're just minutes from wonderful shops and dining at The Hub, accessible via the home's golf cart or adult bikes. Upon entry, the spacious living area and kitchen create a warm and cozy vibe that invites you to create new memories. The living room has plenty of comfortable seating around the flat-screen TV and fireplace, while the gourmet kitchen is fully equipped with stainless-steel appliances to prepare a meal for your group. Enjoy meals at the dining table and breakfast bar, which can seat 12 people combined. The back porch is steps away from the Watersound 18 hole putting green course, balls and putter provided. The back porch also has an outdoor dining table and fireplace for an even better spot to enjoy the evening together, no matter the season. There is a half-bathroom and laundry room down the hall and the primary bedroom, which has a king bed and attached bathroom with double vanities. Upstairs, guests have the perfect work-from-home set up with an office nook. There is an additional living room as well with a flat-screen TV. A bunk room is adjacent to the second-floor living area and features a full-over-full bunk bed and a bathroom that is shared with the neighboring bedroom, which has a king bed. The remaining 2 guest rooms upstairs are spacious executive suites both having king beds, flat screen TV's, and their own large bathrooms attached.Outside, there is a grilling station and outdoor shower that is perfect for rinsing off after a long, sunshine-filled day at the beach. You don't want to miss your chance to stay at this fabulous WaterSound home! Book today for an unforgettable stay at "Tidepool Treasure".SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 12) FIRST FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Half Bath Toilet OnlySECOND FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: Full over Full Bunkbed, Shared Bathroom Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed Shared Bathroom Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
